description: Carreteras is a dataset listed in Diputació de Castelló open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Diputación Provincial de Castelló/Castellón. Mapa de carreteras existentes en la provincia de Castellón con indicación de su estado, según la Encuesta de Infraestructura y Equipamientos Locales (EIEL), en su edición de 2024. Coverage: Province of Castellón. The portal files it under Urban planning and infrastructures. Its keywords are movilidad, geolocalizado, provincia de Castellón. The portal shows 1,227 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-05-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datosabiertos-dipcas-es-portal.
